description: This file implements a routing strategy class 'LowestCostLoggingHandler' for selecting deployment models based on response time and cost metrics, including methods for logging success events and selecting the lowest cost deployment.

classes.name: LowestCostLoggingHandler
classes.description: A custom logger class that tracks and updates usage metrics for models based on response time and cost, and provides deployment selection based on lowest cost.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful response event, updating usage metrics in cache.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful response event, updating usage metrics in cache.

methods.name: async_get_available_deployments
methods.description: Selects the deployment with the lowest cost that meets usage constraints.
